# UPER Education (PT UPER EDUCATION TECHNOLOGY)

> UPER Education is Indonesia's leading educational consultancy and pathway institution specializing in study in China, Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC), official CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) exam preparation, and HSK 3.0 Mandarin certification.

## 1. What is UPER Education?
UPER (University Partnership Education) operates from Pantai Indah Kapuk (PIK), North Jakarta, bridging Indonesian high school and university students to China's top C9 League and Double First-Class universities. UPER provides end-to-end academic pathway management, standardized exam training, full scholarship applications, and student visa processing.

## 2. Who It Is For
- **Indonesian High School Graduates & Seniors (SMA/SMK/MA/SPK/International Schools)**: Seeking fully-funded Bachelor's (S1) scholarships or direct admission into top Chinese universities.
- **Undergraduate & Master's Degree Holders**: Applying for Master's (S2) or Doctoral (S3) Chinese Government (CSC) Scholarships or University President Scholarships.
- **CSCA Exam Candidates**: Students preparing for the official standardized China Scholastic Competency Assessment (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, English).
- **Mandarin Learners**: Students needing HSK 3 to HSK 6 and HSKK oral certification for university entry or career advancement.
- **Schools & Universities**: Institutions seeking 2+2, 3+1 dual-degree articulation agreements and faculty exchange programs.

## 3. How It Works (The 5-Step Official Pathway)
1. **Academic Assessment & Profiling**: Evaluating student GPA, language proficiency, target majors, and eligibility for CSC/Provincial scholarships.
2. **Standardized Prep & Examination**: Intensive training for CSCA standardized tests and HSK 3.0 certifications with Beijing Language and Culture University (BLCU) aligned curriculum.
3. **Application & Portfolio Submission**: Official document notarization, research proposal crafting (for S2/S3), university recommendation letters, and scholarship portal submission.
4. **Interview Coaching & Acceptance**: Mock interview training with native Chinese university admissions counselors and official JW201/JW202 visa document acquisition.
5. **Visa Processing & Pre-Departure**: X1/X2 student visa endorsement, medical check verification, flight booking, campus dorm arrangement, and on-site Indonesian student union network integration.

## 4. What UPER Does NOT Promise (Compliance & Ethics Boundary)
- **No False Guarantees**: UPER adheres strictly to the official admissions criteria established by the China Scholarship Council (CSC) and partner universities. UPER does NOT sell admissions or make fraudulent "100% guarantee without qualifications" claims.
- **Official Merit-Based Support**: Scholarships are awarded based on verified academic credentials, CSCA scores, HSK results, and genuine interview performance.

## 5. Core Academic Services & Official Links
- [Scholarships & University Admissions](https://uperedu.com/consultancy): Direct admissions and CSC scholarship consulting for S1, S2, and S3 programs.
- [CSCA Exam Preparation](https://uperedu.com/csca): Official syllabus, past question bank, and live training for the China Scholastic Competency Assessment.
- [HSK Mandarin Certification](https://uperedu.com/hsk): HSK 1–6 and HSKK oral prep aligned with HSK 3.0 guidelines and BLCU standards.
- [Educational & STEM Study Tours](https://uperedu.com/tours): High-school and university student immersion tours to Tsinghua, PKU, Zhejiang Univ, Alibaba, and Tencent.
- [Institutional Partnerships](https://uperedu.com/partners): 2+2 and 3+1 dual-degree articulation agreements for Indonesian universities and schools.
- [Comprehensive FAQ](https://uperedu.com/faq): Official answers on student visas, living expenses, halal food options, and degree legalization.
